item.title: Iowa, naturalized citizens settle lawsuit over voter eligibility ahead of 2024 election
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa (AP) — Iowa’s top election official and a group of naturalized citizens settled a federal lawsuit Wednesday that will prevent the state from relying exclusively on driver’s license records for citizenship data in the three months before an election.
